description: This Java source file defines the 'RelatedItemsController' class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing related product items within an e-commerce admin interface. It includes methods for displaying related items, paging through related products, and adding or removing related products, utilizing services for product, category, and product relationship management.

classes.name: RelatedItemsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for managing related product items within the admin section of an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: displayRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the related items page, retrieving the product and associated categories, validating ownership.

methods.name: pageRelatedItems
methods.description: Processes POST requests to retrieve a paginated list of related products for a given product, returning JSON data.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a related product to the specified base product, validating permissions and updating relationships.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a related product from a base product, validating permissions and deleting the relationship.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the menu context for the web view.
